profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a for-profit public company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It trades under the ticker SFTBF and has SEC CIK 0001065521. Its official site identifies Masayoshi Son as representative director, chairman and president executive officer, and says the site provides information on the company's philosophy, vision, strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations, business segments and group companies, and sustainability (ESG) information.

The available site text does not name specific AI products. Recent notices on the site include a September 2, 2026 announcement about SB Energy's public filing of a registration statement for an initial public offering. The site also posts warnings about fake investment solicitations that impersonate Masayoshi Son or the SoftBank Group, and about unrelated entities and services, including "軟銀ソリューションズ株式会社", "幸福空間股份有限公司", "Arbisoo", and "SBC Card".
